## Summary

Describe the game idea or catalog change, including the approved idea/vision credit if relevant.

## Tests

- [ ] `node scripts/build.mjs --check`
- [ ] `node scripts/validate.mjs`
- [ ] `node --test tests/*.test.mjs`
- [ ] Played the game through its win/replay flows
- [ ] Checked keyboard, mobile/touch, and downloaded HTML offline
- [ ] No remote assets/analytics or personal data collection
- [ ] Updated `plan.md` if needed
